items.source: Note: if the interceptor throws an exception after receiving a response, it must close the response via ClientHttpResponse.close().
items.translation: 注意：如果拦截器在接收响应后抛出异常，它必须通过ClientHttpResponse.close()关闭该响应。

items.source: Description copied from interface: ClientHttpRequestInterceptor
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：ClientHttpRequestInterceptor

items.source:
Create a new interceptor which adds Basic Authentication for the
given username and password.
items.translation: 创建一个新的拦截器，为给定的用户名和密码添加基本身份验证。

items.source:
Create a new interceptor which adds Basic Authentication for the
given username and password, encoded using the specified charset.
items.translation: 创建一个为给定用户名和密码添加基本身份验证的新拦截器，密码使用指定的字符集进行编码。

items.source: intercept in interface ClientHttpRequestInterceptor
items.translation: `intercept` 接口 `ClientHttpRequestInterceptor` 中

items.source: either execute the request using ClientHttpRequestExecution.execute(HttpRequest, byte[])
items.translation: either 使用 ClientHttpRequestExecution.execute(HttpRequest, byte[]) 执行请求。

items.source: Examine the request and body.
items.translation: 检查request和body。

items.source: Optionally wrap the request to filter HTTP attributes.
items.translation: 可选地wrap请求以过滤 HTTP 属性。

items.source: username - the username to use
items.translation: username - 要使用的用户名

items.source: password - the password to use
items.translation: password - 要使用的密码

items.source: A typical implementation of this method would follow the following pattern:
items.translation: 该方法的典型实现将遵循以下模式：

items.source: ClientHttpRequestInterceptor to apply a given HTTP Basic Authentication username/password pair, unless a custom Authorization header has already been set.
items.translation: ClientHttpRequestInterceptor 以应用给定的 HTTP Basic Authentication 用户名/密码对，除非已设置自定义 Authorization 标头。

items.source: Intercept the given request, and return a response.
items.translation: 拦截给定的请求，并返回响应。

items.source: IOException - in case of I/O errors
items.translation: `IOException` - 在发生 I/O 错误时

items.source: or do not execute the request to block the execution altogether
items.translation: 或 不执行该请求以完全阻止执行。

items.source: charset - the charset to use
items.translation: charset - 要使用的字符集

items.source: request - the request, containing method, URI, and headers
items.translation: request - 请求，包含方法、URI 和标头

items.source: body - the body of the request
items.translation: body - 请求的主体

items.source: execution - the request execution
items.translation: execution - 请求执行

items.source: Optionally modify the body of the request.
items.translation: 可选地修改请求的主体。

items.source: Optionally wrap the response to filter HTTP attributes.
items.translation: 可选地包装响应以过滤 HTTP 属性。

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen

items.translation: 响应
